_comment: Round-3 #2 mutation-gate template. Drop into a jest/TS project root as stryker.config.json, then `npx stryker run`. Measures assertion STRENGTH (kills injected mutants) — the complement to 100% coverage that EvilGenie/test-tamper structurally cannot check. Start break low on critical files, raise gradually. Runs ALONGSIDE .coverage-thresholds.json, never replaces it.
